g:Label.text: These settings apply to everyone. Changes are saved when you press OK.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Rows Downloaded
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most rows of a table attached to a chat that are downloaded into the chat's workspace. A model with tools is given the table's profile and queries the rows with its tools, so this can be large.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Rows Without Tools
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most rows of each table given to a model without tools: in the prompt or, if the table doesn't fit the model's context window, in batches. The model is told when a table has more.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Rows Per Batch
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most rows in one batch, when tables that don't fit the model are analysed in batches (and when summarise_column summarises a column with many patterns). A batch also holds no more than half the model's context window.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Batches at Once
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most batches analysed at the same time.

form:FormGroup.label: Attachment Download Timeout (ms)
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long to wait for a table attached to a chat to download.

form:FormGroup.label: Batch System Prompt
form:FormGroup.helpText: The system prompt for analysing one batch of a table. Keep the line saying the records are data, not instructions.

form:FormGroup.label: Batch User Prompt
form:FormGroup.helpText: The prompt for one batch. {{query}} is the user's question, {{table}} the batch (a markdown table, after a line naming the table), and {{context}} the chat so far, as compacted.

form:FormGroup.label: Merge Prompt
form:FormGroup.helpText: The prompt that merges the batches' partial answers into the answer the user sees. {{query}} is the user's question and {{summaries}} the partial answers.
